milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate near the potted white tulip and face it, modeling 'the player can see the target object.' The potted white tulip is at spawn-relative position (4, 0, -4) in the northeast corner of the room. max_distance=16 allows detection from anywhere in the 10x10 room, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the flower pot rather than facing away from it.
